title: Arcanum Unbounded
summary: A comprehensive collection of Cosmere short fiction spanning multiple worlds, introduced with planetary system essays by the in-world scholar Khriss. Includes The Scadrian System (with The Eleventh Metal and Allomancer Jak and the Pits of Eltania), The Selish System (with The Hope of Elantris and the Hugo Award-winning The Emperor's Soul), The Nalthian System, The Rosharan System (with the exclusive Edgedancer novella featuring Lift), The Threnodite System (with Shadows for Silence in the Forests of Hell), The Drominad System (with Sixth of the Dusk), and the standalone essay The Liar of Partinel. Each story explores a different manifestation of investiture and the fundamental laws that govern the Cosmere, while the essays provide unprecedented insight into the connections between worlds.
archiveDescription: This collection assembles narratives from multiple planetary systems within the Cosmere, each introduced by scholarly essays analyzing the unique magical and physical properties of the respective worlds. The volume includes records from Scadrial, Sel, Nalthis, Roshar, Threnody, and the Drominad system, providing a comparative study of investiture manifestations across different planetary conditions. The accompanying essays represent the most systematic attempt to categorize and understand the underlying unity of Cosmere magic. This accession serves as a reference work for scholars studying cross-world phenomena.
